items.text: Neither language is dying, and neither is a safe bet for every job.
Check these four forces for the exact role you want.
Python Python shows up in about 28 of every 100 tech job postings in one October 2026 sample of 18,752 postings.
Java Java demand comes from large banks, insurers and IT services firms that keep big systems running.

blocks.heading: What AI Does to Each One

items.text: AI coding tools write both languages well.
The survey named system design, technical leadership and mentoring as work that stays human.
So the useful question is not which language AI cannot write.
The four questions tell you whether Java or Python fits you and your situation, and the three proofs show whether you can earn from it, so answer the questions first and then pass the proofs.
Python work is often messy data, notebooks and quick tests.
If you need a paid seat soon, look at where freshers near you are actually hired.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: What the latest data shows, and what it does not

rows: Python is still number 1 at 20.86%, though it fell 2.51 points in a year. Java rose to number 3 at 8.89% and passed C++.
TIOBE measures how popular a language is in searches. It does not measure hiring or quality.
About 58% of developers use Python, up 7 points in a year. 84% use or plan to use AI tools, and 51% of professionals use them daily.
It tells you what developers use, not what freshers get hired for in India.

Python gained about 850,000 contributors, up almost 49%, and Java gained about 175,000, up about 21%. TypeScript passed Python and JavaScript as the most used language by contributor count. India added over 5.2 million developers in 2025.
GitHub counts accounts, not jobs. A growing pool of Indian developers also suggests more people chasing each junior seat.
PrepNPlaced report on LinkedIn and Naukri postings, 26 September to 26 October 2026
Of 18,752 postings, 4.3% were entry level and 51.5% were senior. Python appeared in about 28.2% and SQL in 21.6%. Data engineering rose from 4.3% to 7.7% of postings between July and October.
That report does not give a Java share, so check Java postings yourself.
AccioJob fresher hiring drives, January to May 2026
555 drives, 1,446 openings, 376 companies. 39% of Python backend and full-stack drives mentioned AI, against 3% of Java ones. Median pay was about Rs 6 LPA for both.
It covers drives sent to one training company, so it is a signal, not the whole market.

blocks.heading: Role By Role
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: The better bet, role by role

rows: Automation and scripting for small businesses
A few lines can replace hours of repeated manual work, which is easy for a client to see.
Data engineer postings in the October 2026 sample asked for SQL in 45.2% and Python in 42.7%.
The main libraries and learning material for this work are Python first.
TypeScript is now the most used language on GitHub, and it often fits web product work better than either.
Backend roles at banks, insurers, telecom and large IT services firms
Many of these firms already run big Java systems and hire people to extend them.
Existing Android code still contains a lot of Java, but new work leans Kotlin.
Automation and scripting for small businesses
Scalable You sell a fixed package, set your own price and can add clients or hire help.
Keep a before-and-after note for every job.
Scalable Reports and dashboards can be sold as freelance work, and data engineering rose from 4.3% to 7.7% of postings.
Show one clean dataset turned into one decision.
Scalable The skill sells as consulting or a product, but entry seats are few and the work needs proof.
Add SQL and one real data project.
Scalable You can sell sites and apps to small firms or build a product of your own.
Check what the startups in your city ask for.
Backend roles at banks, insurers, telecom and large IT services firms
Scalable with a business layer A salaried seat follows a fixed ladder. It scales when you own a core service or move into design or consulting.
Read five postings from the exact company you want.
Scalable with a business layer Pay follows apps you can ship. It scales through your own apps or freelance builds, and Java is the older half of the work.
Open current Android openings before you choose.

blocks.heading: New AI, Data and Automation Work Lands

items.text: You can sell the work directly, such as automation and data jobs, so it scales furthest.
Java 25, released 16 September 2025, is a long-term support release, and Oracle says it will support it for at least eight years.
Compact source files let a beginner write a program without the old class and main-method wrapper.
Oracle says Java 25's primitive-type changes will help programs that run trained AI models.
Java 26, released in March 2026, is a short-term release that adds faster startup options and HTTP/3 support.
